provenance.construction: Four-check row-space graft of codes/798-8-27.json by @dorakingx. On the X side XOR source rows [360, 376, 377, 378] to form S=[360, 361, 378, 762, 781, 782]; replace row 376 by S, clear qubit 378 from other X rows using S, apply CNOT fanout from 378 to S\{378}, then delete disentangled qubit 378. Surviving qubits inherit source coordinates.
provenance.notes: A four-check row-space stabilizer yields a geometry-valid qubit reduction. The X and Z logical witnesses are exact Clifford images of the published code witnesses, independently validated on the reduced full matrices. Distance remains a witnessed upper bound; further RIS refutation may lower it.
